topic.title: Release notes for 0.1
topic.shortdesc: The first release of : the build and filter core, the hosted path, embedded help and PDF publications.

ul.li: A DITA 1.3 subset parsed in TypeScript, with line and column for every problem: topics, maps, bookmaps, keys, conref and conkeyref.

One applicability rule: product and feature against entitlements, release ranges against the reader's version, other attributes through a build-time DITAVAL. Fail-closed, with conditional keys resolved per reader.
A starter template with sample content, a bookmap, reusable chunks, a theme and a validation workflow.
Push to publish: a GitHub webhook queues a build, the worker builds and validates the exact commit, and a failing push never goes live.
Release lines: 1.x and 2.x docs live side by side, each reader served their own line.
OIDC reader sign-in, matched by verified email; filtered pages, navigation and images, cached per entitlement set.
Site-wide search: a search box in the header of every page and a results page that finds only what the reader can see in their release, with stemming, phrases and prefix matching. See .
An admin API with an audit log, a seed command, one Docker image for every role, a Compose file, S3-compatible blob storage, published images, and a Railway runbook.
resourceid context keys with parent fallback, and route patterns in help-contexts.yaml.
An embeddable help panel with per-reader search, the OpenDHelp widget and <opend-help-button>, host-signed tokens and partitioned sessions.
A JSON API for apps that render help themselves, and the previewer's help lab.
Bookmaps printed per reader through the same filter, with a cover, linked contents, an outline and the project theme.
Print HTML and PDFs in the previewer; cached per release and entitlement set on the server.
Not supported yet: DTD specialisation, conrefend, relationship tables, key scopes and branch filtering. See .
The contents list in PDFs has no page numbers.
One docs site and one embed secret per deployment.
No web editor or operator console yet.
